name: Download every image from a website (zip) with MiroMiro

parameters.content:
### How it works
This workflow helps designers, developers and content teams collect every image from a web page in one run. You give it a URL. The MiroMiro node opens the page and lists every image it shows: img tags, srcset sizes, picture sources, CSS backgrounds, favicons and the og:image. n8n removes duplicate URLs, downloads each file and packs them into one zip named after the site. A download that fails is skipped and counted, so one broken link does not stop the run. If the page has no images, or cannot be reached, the workflow stops with a message that says why. Failed calls are not charged.

### Setup
This template uses the verified community node **n8n-nodes-miromiro** (tested with version 0.1.3 on n8n 1.123). On n8n Cloud, search "MiroMiro" in the nodes panel. On self-hosted n8n, install it from Settings > Community nodes: https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/community-nodes/installation/
1. Get a free MiroMiro API key (300 credits a month, no card): https://miromiro.app/api/onboarding
2. Open **List the images on the page** > Credential > Create new, and paste the key.
3. Set your page in **Settings** > website and click **Execute workflow**.
4. Download the zip from **Zip the images** > Binary.

Each page costs 1 credit. The same page again within 24 hours is free.

### Customization
For images that only load when you scroll, open the MiroMiro node > Additional Options > Render in a Browser (+5 credits). Replace **Run** with a Schedule trigger or a Google Sheets list to process many pages, and send the zip to Google Drive or email instead of downloading it. Pages behind a login cannot be read.

nodes.name: List the images on the page

parameters.content:
## Choose the page
Put the page you want in **Settings** > website.

## Find the images
MiroMiro lists every image the page shows. Duplicates are removed; a page with no images stops here with a message.

## Download and zip
Each image is downloaded. Failed downloads are skipped and counted, the rest go into one zip.
